caption: The drawing is composed of delicate, curving lines rendered in a light blue color against a cream or off-white background. The main elements include two large, vertically oriented, sinuous vines, each with leaves, small flowers, and berries distributed along their length, forming mirror images on the right and left sides of the composition. In the center towards the bottom is a conical structure with a textured, checkered pattern, and beside it are symmetrical, scrolling tendrils. Smaller floral motifs and leaves are scattered throughout the space between and around the central vines, including detailed bunches of grapes, stylized blossoms, and individual leaves with visible veins. Some of the vines terminate in large, bell-shaped flowers or clusters of smaller circular fruits. The overall composition is framed by a thin outline, and there is handwritten text at the lower edge, with the left side labeled “A-1671. A.” and the right side signed “Ruth M. Barnes.”
title: Coverlet
